RIDER SMALL AT THE CONTROLS: a tiny helmeted figure seen from behind at the controls of the ride, a scarf trailing, turned toward the way ahead
DRIVER SMALL AND UPRIGHT: a small capped figure sitting upright at the controls of the ride, seen from behind, the route stretching beyond
RIDER AT THE CREST: a tiny helmeted figure on the ride, seen from behind, a bright scarf lifting gently as the route dips away
PILOT SMALL IN THE DISTANCE: a small goggled figure at the controls of the ride, far along the route, turned fully toward the way ahead
DOG RIDING ALONG: a small dog sitting up in the sidecar or on the seat beside the driver, ears back, tiny in the frame
DOG AT THE WINDOW: a small dog with its head out of the van window, ears lifted, tiny against the passing fields
DOG ON THE SLED SEAT: a small dog sitting on the sled seat, fur ruffled by the cold air, tiny and still
GULLS ON THE POST: three small gulls resting on a far post beside the route, wings folded, still in the grey light
GULLS WHEELING FAR: tiny gulls turning high and far above the water, small pale shapes against a wide sky
GULL ON THE RAIL: a small gull settled on a far fence rail, feathers smoothed, small against the open distance
SHEEP AT THE FENCE: three small sheep pressed against the fence beside the route, woolly and still, far in the frame
COWS AT THE GATE: two small cows standing at the field fence, heads low, tiny beside the passing route
SHEEP ON THE VERGE: a small cluster of sheep at the fence edge, far and pale against the green, still and small
GOAT ON THE ROCK: a small goat standing high on a rock above the route, sure-footed, tiny against the wide sky
DEER ON THE LEDGE: a small deer paused on a rock above the road, ears up, far and still in the frame
GOAT ABOVE THE PASS: a tiny goat on a high rock above the route, small against the pale stone, watching
HORSES IN THE PADDOCK: two small horses far in the paddock beside the road, standing quiet, tiny in the green distance
HORSES AT THE RAIL: two far horses near the paddock fence, small and calm, tails swaying in the wide field
CAT ON THE CAMPER STEP: a small cat curled on the camper step, tucked and warm, tiny at the edge of the frame
CAT ON THE BENCH: a small cat sitting on the station bench, tail wrapped around its paws, tiny and still
HERON AT THE EDGE: a small heron standing at the water's edge, tall and still, far and thin in the frame
DUCKS ON THE BANK: two small ducks resting at the water's edge, still and close together, tiny in the reeds
FIGURE AT THE GATE: a tiny figure far at the field gate, turned away, one arm raised in a small wave
FIGURE AT THE FIELD EDGE: a small figure far along the field edge, turned away, waving slowly toward the passing route
BIRDS FROM THE HEDGE: a small flock lifting gently from the hedgerow, tiny dark shapes scattering into the pale open sky
